newsitem.title: ERITREA: President receives Eritrea's first constitution.
newsitem.headline: President receives Eritrea's first constitution.

text.p: President Isayas Afewerki received Eritrea's first constitution on Saturday at celebrations in the capital to mark the fourth anniversary of independence.
A 527-person constituent assembly made up of members of the national assembly and regional assemblies and representatives of Eritreans living abroad ratified the constitution on Friday.
Eritrea became independent on May 24, 1993, after 30 years of guerrilla war against the Ethiopian government until the overthrow of Marxist military dictator Mengistu Haile Mariam in 1991.
